title: Starbucks Coffee Company 2009 CALIFORNIA Collector Series 16oz Mug
descriptionText: This Starbucks 16oz mug is part of the 2009 California Collector Series. It features a multicolor design and was created in China. The mug is an original piece and is perfect for coffee and tea enthusiasts. The brand, Starbucks, is well-known for its high-quality products and this mug is no exception. It would make a great addition to any collection or a thoughtful gift for a loved one who enjoys a good cup of coffee.
